# Human Rights Watch

> > Human Rights Watch (HRW) is a global human rights advocacy organization defending rights in 100+ countries through research, documentation, and advocacy on war crimes, refugee rights, racial justice, LGBT rights, and international law.

Human Rights Watch conducts investigations and advocacy on human rights violations worldwide, working with the United Nations, Human Rights Council, and governments to address issues from immigration detention to climate justice. The organization operates through regional divisions, local committees, and specialized programs focused on women's rights, LGBT rights, and environmental justice.

## Key Topics

- Human Rights Watch (HRW)
- War crimes and international law
- Refugee and asylum rights
- Immigration detention
- Racial justice
- LGBT rights
- Women's rights
- United Nations and Human Rights Council
- Israel-Palestine conflict
- US human rights policy
- Environmental and climate justice
- Regional advocacy (Ethiopia, Syria, Iran, Philippines)
- Leadership and staff profiles
- Advisory committees
- Fundraising and support

- [Human Rights Watch | Defending Human Rights Worldwide](https://www.hrw.org): Homepage for Human Rights Watch defending rights in 100+ countries

- [People | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people): Staff directory and leadership team at Human Rights Watch

## Leadership and Staff Profiles

- [Alison Leal Parker | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/alison-leal-parker): US Program director on immigration, racial justice, and border policy
- [Abir Ghattas | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/abir-ghattas): Chief Information Officer profile for technology and security strategy
- [Abbey Koenning-Rutherford | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/abbey-koenning-rutherford): US researcher on indigenous rights, immigration, and racial justice
- [Adam Frankel | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/adam-frankel): LGBT Rights researcher on transgender immigrants and detention issues
- [Agathe Bounfour | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/agathe-bounfour): Environment researcher on fossil fuels, climate crisis, and energy policy
- [Alex Neve | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/alex-neve): Author on Snowden refugees, asylum seekers, and Canada immigration

## Advisory Committees and Divisions

- [Women's Rights Division | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/advisory-committee/womens-rights-division): Women's Rights Division advisory committee leadership members
- [Stockholm Committee | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/advisory-committee/stockholm-committee): Stockholm Committee of 18 members chaired by Anna Manhusen
- [London Next Gen Community | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/people/advisory-committee/london-next-gen-community): London Next Gen young professionals network chaired by Brooks & Small

## Local Chapters and Communities
